method.points: Fit each arm's point at the strict maximum admitted score over ordinary development deliveries, including gain, genuine resampling, untouched, and background-only at all four noise settings. Freeze the points and complete development records before held inference.
method.raw: Compare the existing Full four-second window grid and the existing five two-second short-review windows. Each route uses the same pinned voice classifier, normalization, and independent per-view speech gate. Select the highest admitted raw logit; earlier window breaks ties. The production two-second point is reported as a diagnostic. The six-second source is outside whole-file confidence calibration.
method.readout: A strict localization must cover half the edit and achieve at least 0.30 interval intersection over union. A separate broad range covers half the edit irrespective of extra time. Also report availability, misplaced flags, exact-control false flags, stronger raw score than the matched ordinary replacement and best-response timing before operating points. Repeated mixtures share their source reader and masker.
method.reduction: A separate two-second arm applies the fixed previously published 512-point frequency power subtraction on the full mixture; no isolated reference or ground-truth edit enters the transform. Use the same speech-coverage rule on the processed view. It is a standalone arm, not an unvalidated addition to the primary rule.
